data.narrative:
Precision AI is a Series A stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, founded by Daniel McCann, having raised $20M to date. The comparable universe consists of 8 private companies in this space, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro; no public comparables exist in this narrow frontier-tech segment.

Valuation triangulation relied on a single applicable method due to data constraints. Stage-Progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $20M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $40M. Peer-Median methodology was not applicable: while 7 same-sector peers exist, insufficient narrow-stage cohorts were available (0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier peers identified), and a broad all-sector median would introduce undue noise given the specialized nature of frontier autonomous systems.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M to $46M, centered on $40M. This range reflects typical stage-progression step-ups with modest upside and downside bands. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct same-stage comparables, which limits validation of the 2.0x multiplier's appropriateness for Precision AI's specific market position and technology maturity. Additional diligence on unit economics, technical differentiation, and deployment traction would be required to refine the range boundaries.
